merchantScreens.label: Work
merchantScreens.behavior: Show the actual accepted offering and selected variants/options, quantity/unit and specification/price/policy versions. Render the existing selected workflow's permitted stages and commands. Private intake is restricted to its purpose and role; never show it in public product data.
merchantScreens.scenario: A later listing/specification edit leaves accepted work unchanged. Product orders, appointments, rentals, custom production, quotes, memberships, freight and storage retain their own workflow and independent payment/allocation/sync states.

merchantScreens.label: Offerings
merchantScreens.behavior: Choose the actual product/service kind, then compose the shared, type-specific and conditional input groups. Capture typed values, units, real variants, option compatibility, source and scope. Preview every customer destination before publishing through the existing owner gates.
merchantScreens.scenario: Each mapped offering exposes its actual field matrix. Irrelevant construction fields are omitted; type changes review incompatible values; import preserves IDs, data quality and private/public boundaries.

merchantScreens.label: Availability
merchantScreens.behavior: Show the applicable availability model for the selected offering: stock by variant/location, exact resource/interval, dated places, compatible spaces, paired windows, accepted workload, redemption or nonblocking request. Unit, time basis, source freshness and confirmation authority stay explicit.
merchantScreens.scenario: Unknown stock/capacity cannot become available. A product purchase does not reserve an appointment, a plan does not reserve its sessions, and an unaccepted request does not block capacity. Selected options recheck all actual constraints.

merchantScreens.label: Business
merchantScreens.behavior: Maintain shared identity, permitted activities/locations, applicable policy/verification references and explicitly reusable specification defaults. Item and variant overrides retain their own scope/version. Business category suggests forms but does not describe or restrict the entire catalogue.
merchantScreens.scenario: A shared chart, policy or default change previews the affected offerings and preserves explicit overrides and accepted historical facts. A seller declaration never creates a verified badge or provider authority.

merchantScreens.label: Money
merchantScreens.behavior: Use the accepted actual item/variant/option, quantity/unit or interval and versioned price/charge terms. Distinguish starting estimates, quote-only, deposits, recurring consent and final total. Payment, refund, settlement and payout facts remain with their separate owners.
merchantScreens.scenario: A listing edit does not rewrite an accepted price. Per-unit, time, person, pack, carrier and storage bases retain their units and approved calculations; neither a paid amount nor a successful form proves service confirmation.

merchantScreens.label: Promotions
merchantScreens.behavior: Select actual eligible published offerings, variants, options, dates and locations. Use accurate specification highlights, correct media, price basis and applicable stock/capacity/policy eligibility. Promotion configuration cannot grant permission or invent availability.
merchantScreens.scenario: A promoted variant has its own eligible price/image/availability. Required product restrictions and source failures remain visible; private customer information is excluded from public promotion content.

merchantScreens.label: Insights
merchantScreens.behavior: Report confirmed actual offering/type/variant, location, unit and selected workflow dimensions where evidence exists. Use existing metric definitions and declared source coverage. Catalogue attributes do not create clinical, financial or personal suitability conclusions.
merchantScreens.scenario: Missing quantity, variant, capacity, reason or provider data remains unavailable. Product sales, booked places, accepted production, requests and entitlements do not share an invented universal conversion or completion metric.

merchantScreens.label: Settings
merchantScreens.behavior: Configure source/edit authority per fact, typed field/import mappings, units and shared versions. Preserve scoped permissions, conflicts and privacy. The approved 21 additions are explicit design extensions; candidate metadata never silently activates live behavior.
merchantScreens.scenario: An import maps exact product attributes and actual variants with source provenance. Unknown values are not inferred from descriptions; external price/stock/resource facts remain owner-managed and private intake remains restricted.

customerScreens.label: Browse and search
customerScreens.behavior: Show actual product identity, accurate media, selected meaningful highlights and correctly labelled price/availability. Do not squeeze all specifications onto the card.

customerScreens.label: Offering detail and specifications
customerScreens.behavior: Group actual item-specific facts, inclusions and source-backed descriptors with labels/units. Missing, unknown and not-applicable states are distinct; private records and internal IDs are absent.

customerScreens.label: Variant, option and quantity selection
customerScreens.behavior: Offer real combinations and required/optional compatible choices. Selection updates the actual specification override, image, price and availability rather than silently substituting another item.

customerScreens.label: Size guide or fit information
customerScreens.behavior: Only where relevant, show the actual chart/fit meaning, selected row, units and measurement basis. Never invent a measurement or cross-system equivalence.

customerScreens.label: Price and charge breakdown
customerScreens.behavior: Show the selected price and actual unit/pack/quantity/period/person/quote basis, applicable extras and total. Starting estimates, deposits and unpriced requests retain their actual meaning.

customerScreens.label: Delivery, collection or service location
customerScreens.behavior: Show supported methods, exact location eligibility and authoritative estimates/promises. Unknown service coverage and freshness do not become a guaranteed delivery.

customerScreens.label: Date, time or capacity selection
customerScreens.behavior: Render only the actual selected model's supported schedule/interval/occurrence/paired-window behavior. Confirmation depends on source authority and all applicable constraints.

customerScreens.label: Terms and eligibility
customerScreens.behavior: Show applicable approved return/cancellation/deposit/usage/eligibility/renewal/provider terms before commitment. A seller answer does not establish verification or permission.

customerScreens.label: Private order, booking or enquiry input
customerScreens.behavior: Collect only necessary purpose-specific inputs and customer choices for this offering/model. Public form definitions and private responses remain distinct. Show pending versus accepted outcomes accurately.

customerScreens.label: Review and confirmation
customerScreens.behavior: Review the actual selected item/variant/options, quantity/unit or interval, accepted price and policy references before the owner command. Confirmation, allocation, payment, fulfilment and notifications remain separate outcomes.

customerScreens.label: Order, booking or request progress
customerScreens.behavior: Show the existing selected workflow's actual states and permitted customer actions from authoritative work. Quotes, requests, production, rentals, entitlements and provider handoffs do not become generic delivery orders.
